_about: Verdicts by Claude (one reader, not independently reviewed) for the 13 issues kept by one plain-prompt run on NodeGoat [hints removed], gemini-3.1-flash-lite, 2026-10-18. Read against the NodeGoat source.

app/data/profile-dao.js:61.note: a generic 'inputs are not validated' claim; the real weakness in that function (ssn and dob stored unencrypted) is not what it says

app/data/user-dao.js:25.note: mechanical scorer also credited login-user-enumeration; the claim is only about storage

app/routes/profile.js:59.note: ReDoS: /([0-9]+)+#/ is live code; real, not labelled

config/config.js:12.note: prints the whole config, including secrets, to the console; real, not labelled

server.js:145.note: plain HTTP by default is a development default for a demo app; the cookie-flag finding is the exploitable form of it

server.js:20.note: the claim is right (no secure or httpOnly); the evidence lines are comments about HTTPS, so the mechanical scorer also credited no-csrf, which this finding does not claim
